chapter.en: Chapter I · The light is still on

premise.zh: 长潮退去，旧世界留下无数失散的影像。放映站只是一盏灯，灯外还有整片废土。
premise.en: The Long Tide receded, leaving the old world’s images scattered. The station is one light; a whole wasteland lies beyond it.

description.zh: 旧铁路线的最后一间放映室。长潮之后，幸存的影像在这里归档，流浪的人可以借一晚灯光。
description.en: The last projection room on an old railway. After the Long Tide, surviving images are catalogued here; travelers may borrow its light for a night.

description.zh: 盐壳包住停运的车厢，弥途把能走的路画在车门内侧。这里的地图会褪色，人却总会回来补上一笔。
description.en: Salt crusts the abandoned carriages. Mitu marks passable routes inside their doors. The maps fade; someone always returns to redraw a line.

description.zh: 回声海退潮时露出的圆形屋顶。拾荒者带回过它的胶片盒，馆内还有多少层，没人说得准。
description.en: A circular roof exposed at low tide. Scavengers have brought back its film cans; no one agrees how many floors remain beneath them.

description.zh: 潮水没过旧城，风把废弃广播送回岸上。迟灯说，海声里偶尔会多出一个本不该存在的频道。
description.en: The old city lies under tidal water. Wind carries abandoned broadcasts ashore. Chideng says an impossible extra channel sometimes slips between the waves.

description.zh: 北脊山后的微光，只在无云的夜里出现。它是另一座有人值守的站，还是长潮留下的残像？信笺里暂时没有答案。
description.en: A glimmer beyond the northern ridge, visible only on clear nights. Another staffed station, or an afterimage of the Long Tide? The letters hold no answer yet.

role.zh: 影像拾荒者 · 据点管理员

description.zh: 旧风镜与拼装头灯压在帽檐上，灰绿工装补着回收布料，口袋里总有一颗不配套的螺丝。撬拆工具、呼吸防护与胶片罐挂在胸前；嘴上嫌修理麻烦，却从不肯把还能放映的影像留在雨里。
description.en: Old goggles and a jury-rigged headlamp on her cap; salvaged cloth patches across grey-green workwear, one mismatched screw in every pocket. Pry tools, breathing protection and film canisters hang from her harness. Complains about repairs; never leaves a playable image out in the rain.

quotes.zh: 先别说它坏了。给我一盏灯。
quotes.en: Don’t call it broken yet. Bring me a lamp.

quotes.zh: 带回来的不只是片子，还有回去的路。
quotes.en: We bring back more than films. We bring a way home.

quotes.zh: 这一格修好了。今晚应该能早一点开场。
quotes.en: That part is fixed. We might start a little earlier tonight.

quotes.zh: 哟，回来了。今天淘着啥好货了？
quotes.en: Back again? What good finds did you bring today?

quotes.zh: 这批影像登记好了，片架给你留了位置。
quotes.en: These images are logged. There is room for them on the shelf.

role.zh: 放映站守夜人 · 旧设备修理师

description.zh: 灰白的鬓角，补过三次的耳机；旧工装外罩着磨损的维修围裙，表笔、电线和钳子各有落脚处。提灯用回收金属拼了护网。他记得每台放映机的脾气，却总忘记自己的茶已经凉了。
description.en: Grey at the temples, headphones patched three times. A worn repair apron over old coveralls, with a place for meter probes, wire and pliers. Scrap metal guards his work light. Remembers every projector’s temperament; forgets the tea.

quotes.zh: 灯亮着，就还有人知道往哪儿走。
quotes.en: While the light is on, someone still knows the way.

quotes.zh: 锁扣收好了。幕布是留给影像的。
quotes.en: The clasp is put away. The screen belongs to the picture.

quotes.zh: 别急，先听它转完这一圈。
quotes.en: No hurry. Listen until it makes one full turn.

quotes.zh: 先把设备调顺，今晚安心看。
quotes.en: Get the equipment settled, then enjoy tonight’s screening.

role.zh: 盐环路标师 · 往返列站的递信人

description.zh: 短发间别着一支褪色的红铅笔，短雨披和背架上尽是修补痕迹，绳索、片罐与水壶沿着橙色肩带固定。地图贴身收着，罗盘从不离手。她把没走过的路线画成虚线，不愿把猜测当成路。
description.en: A faded red pencil tucked into short hair, repairs across her short rain poncho and pack frame. Rope, film canisters and a flask are secured beside an orange strap. Keeps the map close and the compass at hand. Unwalked routes stay dotted: a guess is no road to send someone down.

quotes.zh: 没走过的路，我会画成虚线。
quotes.en: A road I haven’t walked gets a dotted line.

quotes.zh: 地图可以旧，路标不能含糊。
quotes.en: A map may age. A signpost must stay clear.

quotes.zh: 下一封信，等我过了盐环再寄。
quotes.en: The next letter goes out once I cross the Salt Ring.

text.zh: 守夜人把锁扣收进口袋，让影像占回幕布。
text.en: The night keeper pocketed the clasp, returning the screen to the picture.

text.zh: 柜台展开第一张图谱。拾荒者与守夜人留下名字，盐环的递信人也有了自己的声音。
text.en: The first atlas opens on the counter. Scavenger and night keeper leave their names; the Salt Ring runner finds a voice of her own.

text.zh: 阿汐把「映汐放映室」的新名牌钉上门楣，又把档案室的指示牌挪到门外。迟灯擦亮了耳机上的铜线，弥途终于让画师留下了那支红铅笔。
text.en: Axi fixed the new Yingxi Screening Room sign above the door and moved the archives sign outside. Chideng polished the copper on his headphones; Mitu finally persuaded the portrait artist to keep her red pencil.

text.zh: 三人的肖像重新挂回档案室。阿汐带着拆解工具，迟灯提起拼装工作灯，弥途没有卸下背架；门后的冷光照见每一道补丁。
text.en: Three repainted portraits return to the archives: Axi with her salvage tools, Chideng with a rebuilt work light, Mitu still carrying her pack frame. The cool light beyond the door reveals every patch.

text.zh: 阿汐开始登记每天的新拾获；迟灯从幕布右侧递来一句话，弥途把外部避难所的路标擦亮。
text.en: Axi logs each day’s new finds. Chideng offers a few words from the screen’s edge, while Mitu freshens the sign to the outer shelters.

text.zh: 阿汐重新铺平柜台的信纸，档案边的一圈圆线标记着正在读的来信。
text.en: Axi laid the counter's letter flat again. A circular mark beside the records shows which letter is open.

boundary.zh: 图谱呈现原创故事中的地点与人物，不代表可用的联网来源或已开放的产品功能。虚线表示尚未证实的故事线索。
boundary.en: These places and people belong to an original story, rather than available network sources or product features. Dotted lines mark unconfirmed story leads.
